title: Integrability under Lipschitz composition
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a finite measure space, let $U:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be integrable, and let $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be Lipschitz with some constant $c\ge 0$. Then the function $\omega\mapsto\psi(U(\omega))$ is integrable with respect to $\mu$.
